title: Formulas and Semantics in Digital Diplomatics: Research Data and Analysis Materials
description:
Research data and analysis materials accompanying the paper Formulas and Semantics in Digital Diplomatics.

The corpus comprises sixteen notarial charters dated between 1393 and 1486, preserved in the Biblioteca Comunale Sabino Loffredo in Barletta (BCSL). The deposit includes human-validated ANNIE annotations in JSONL, a Jupyter notebook integrating ANNIE and FLAME analyses, and the FLAME outputs used by the notebook.

A repertoire of fourteen clause categories is provided in CSV and RDF/SKOS, with definitions, recognition criteria, documented alignments with the Vocabulaire international de la diplomatique, and corpus examples linked to document identifiers and character offsets.
